results.headline: JPMorgan Q3 Net Income Rises 35% on Higher Interest Income
results.body: JPMorgan Chase reported Q3 2024 net income of $12.9 billion, up 35% from a year earlier, driven by rising net interest income and strong investment banking fees. Revenue of $43.3 billion beat analyst expectations of $41.8 billion. CEO Jamie Dimon warned of geopolitical risks and potential credit deterioration ahead.

results.headline: JPMorgan Raises Full-Year Net Interest Income Guidance to $92.5B
results.body: JPMorgan Chase raised its full-year net interest income guidance to approximately $92.5 billion, up from its prior guidance of $91 billion. The revision reflects higher-for-longer interest rates and strong loan growth. Analysts viewed the revision positively as it signals confidence in the bank's core earnings power.

tool_outputs.query: Oppenheimer and Deutsche Bank on JPM — show those ratings with the Q3 earnings news.

answer:
Deutsche Bank's analyst, Matt O'Connor, has maintained a "Buy" rating on JPMorgan Chase (JPM) and raised the price target to $275.00 from $255.00 following Q3 earnings news. This action reflects strong capital markets performance and better-than-feared credit quality [Source: rating-jpm-003].

Oppenheimer's analyst, Chris Kotowski, has also maintained an "Outperform" rating on JPMorgan Chase with a price target of $265.00, up from $240.00. This upgrade is driven by the recovery in investment banking and strength in net interest income [Source: rating-jpm-002].

The Q3 earnings report showed that JPMorgan Chase reported a 35% rise in net income to $12.9 billion, primarily due to higher net interest income and strong investment banking fees. Revenue of $43.3 billion exceeded analyst expectations by $1.5 billion [Source: news-jpm-001].

JPMorgan also raised its full-year net interest income guidance to approximately $92.5 billion from the previous estimate of $91 billion, indicating confidence in core earnings power [Source: news-jpm-002].
